answer_span_consistency.note: passed: no text immediately precedes the response slot

target_fidelity.note: It is a positive past simple passive declarative with no modal.

naturalness.note: The prompt and response form a coherent active-to-passive transformation.

pedagogical_suitability.note: It provides focused practice of the past passive.

determinacy.note: Other natural responses, such as adding “yesterday” or an agent phrase, are also supported but are not accepted.

non_target_language_simplicity.note: The vocabulary and context are common and transparent.

no_answer_leakage.note: The prompt gives only the noun and verb cues, not the completed passive form.

no_extraneous_grammar.note: Solving requires only the intended past passive construction.

no_world_knowledge.note: No factual or specialist knowledge is needed.
